implementation_notes: Twelve missing Choose One roots and required generated bodies are written; Alternate Reality direct membership is complete in all eleven classes.
Convoke no longer rejects the previously missing Choose One dependency family in the broad physical-cast fixture. This is internal coverage, not independent fidelity certification.
The three incomplete pools retain all catalog members and explicit pre-sampling rejection.
Captured draw sequences draw all requested cards before post-draw refresh, discount or discard, preserving full-hand burns.
Greater Arcane Missiles uses three independently targeted 3-damage hits, with spell damage applied to each.
No new approximation policies, training, learning, deck search, notebook execution or GitHub publication.
Full 27-member Paladin weapon pool now written with all four Maul forms, Sunscreen and the generated Student.
Ceremonial Maul physical base stats and cost persist through copying/return; Spellburst checks the pre-cast equipped UID.
Mana and Choose Thrice programs preserve ordered choices and leave Choose Both charges unused.

Historical conditional fixture retains every card and active/inactive case, using independent copies of one prepared game and one metadata load rather than hundreds of repeated archives/initializations.

mechanics_reference.use: Battlefield-to-hand copies reset ordinary enchantments; native physical replay builder retained.

validation_attempts.outcome: Two broad fixture setup timeouts and stale missing-pool negative fixture; all repaired without removing cases.

fixture_repair: All original conditional active/inactive cases retained; one prepared independent Game prototype, one metadata load and per-test patches replace repeated archive loads and repeated fixture initialization.

validation_receipt.scope: Non-training engine fixtures only; learning integration and policy-update scenarios excluded. Not full Standard certification.

passing_regressions_do_not_certify: The 53 missing direct historical spell outcomes remain explicit pre-sampling errors. Existing special-card approximation policies remain labeled; no independent client fidelity claim.

additional_mechanics_references.use: Original reveal describes three independent choices, permitting every ordered combination.
Choose Thrice is distinct from Choose One; does not combine with Fandral effects.
Generated Student retains matching base stats and cost through later use.
